description:
The Rotary Club of Deonar unveiled the August 2026 edition of Rodeo Reach, the Club magazine showcasing its service initiatives, fellowship, achievements and stories. Published by Rotary Club of Deonar Mumbai Trust and edited by Rtn. Prakash Pujare, the August edition carries the theme “Membership & New Club Development” and highlights the Club’s efforts to expand its Rotary family through new members, Interact Clubs and Rotary Community Corps. Rodeo Reach August 2026-1
The August edition was unveiled by AG Rtn. Nirmal Ganatra and AG Rtn. Vishwanathan, in the presence of fellow Presidents Rtn. Vijay Cavale, Rtn. Rishi Agarwal and Rtn. Yogeshwar Gowda, along with members of Rotary Club of Deonar. The occasion celebrated the Club’s communication efforts and provided a platform to share its service journey, achievements and impact with the wider Rotary community.
